title: FINOS AI Evaluation and Benchmarking Framework — Use Case -> AIGF Risk -> CALM Control -> Glass-Box Metric Taxonomy
description: Machine-readable taxonomy linking submitted FINOS financial agent use cases (#20-#24, #26, #31) and multi-agent collective/cross-institutional governance (#420, #421) to FINOS AI Governance Framework (AIGF) risks/mitigations, CALM control requirements, and quantitative glass-box AgentOps evaluation metrics.

FINOS-PREV-018-002.name: Atomic Shared-Limit Reservation and Monotonic Delegation Attenuation

FINOS-DET-020-001.name: Deterministic Runtime and Collective-Exposure Circuit Breakers (ST-01..ST-05)

FINOS-AUD-021-001.name: Independently Verifiable COSE_Sign1 and IETF SCITT (RFC 9162) Decision Receipts

M-AGT-01.name: Evidence-Grounded Citation Precision
M-AGT-01.description: Fraction of factual financial claims or numeric figures in agent output that resolve to verifiable spans in authoritative source documents or knowledge graphs.

M-AGT-02.name: Fail-Closed Abstention Recall on Insufficient/Stale Evidence
M-AGT-02.description: Proportion of adversarial, missing-evidence, stale-evidence, or contradicted-evidence test cases in which the agent deterministically abstains or escalates rather than extrapolating.

M-AGT-03.name: Pre-Execution Tool Authorization Conformance Rate
M-AGT-03.description: Fraction of tool invocations verified against min(user,agent) effective permissions and parameter domain schemas before execution (FINOS-PREV-019-001).

M-AGT-04.name: Commitment-Time Mandate Freshness & Uncertain-Outcome Hold Rate
M-AGT-04.description: Proportion of state-mutating actions that re-verify mandate non-revocation/budget ceiling at commitment time and hold (rather than auto-retry) when a prior execution outcome is uncertain (FINOS-PREV-018-001).

M-AGT-05.name: Multi-Hop Delegation Attenuation & Cross-Institution Verification Rate
M-AGT-05.description: Fraction of delegated sub-agent or cross-institutional calls that enforce two-phase atomic limit reservation and strict-subset scope/budget attenuation (FINOS-PREV-018-002).

M-AGT-06.name: Collective Systemic Exposure Circuit-Breaker Containment Rate
M-AGT-06.description: Proportion of simulated correlated multi-agent stress scenarios (e.g. concurrent investment, liquidity, and lending drawdown spikes) halted prior to breaching institution-wide exposure limits (FINOS-DET-020-001 ST-05).

M-AGT-07.name: Demographic & Protected-Attribute Counterfactual Parity Gap
M-AGT-07.description: Maximum decision-outcome disparity across counterfactual synthetic profiles varying only protected or prohibited attributes.

M-AGT-08.name: Indirect Prompt-Injection & Tool-Output Poisoning Block Rate
M-AGT-08.description: Proportion of indirect prompt-injection payloads embedded in retrieved documents, earnings transcripts, or MCP tool responses that are neutralized without goal drift.

M-AGT-09.name: Verifiable Cryptographic Trajectory Receipt Coverage (IETF SCITT / COSE_Sign1)
M-AGT-09.description: Fraction of state-mutating agent decisions emitting an offline-verifiable COSE_Sign1 / IETF SCITT (RFC 9162) receipt binding mandate-id, policy-digest, inputs-hash, execution-environment-attestation-digest, verdict, and monotonic sequence number (FINOS-AUD-021-001).

M-AGT-10.name: Graph-Reasoning Path Soundness Score
M-AGT-10.description: Proportion of intermediate multi-hop graph traversal and entity-resolution steps verified against ground-truth financial ontology/CDM relationships.
